description.text: First-degree subject of sociology master training spot project 1. Aims of the programme This first-degree master training point sets up courses containing sociology, anthropology and folklore.The detailed research aspects concluded: metropolitan sociology, organic sociology, sociology for community of town and country, analysis of social net, family sociology, financial anthropology, law anthropolgy, social folklore, literatural folklore and so on. To culture masters with better ability in theory research, field survey, decision-making and consulting. 2. Duration The fixed year number for learning is usually three years for masters. 3．Major Setup Major Research Aspect Sociology1. methropolitan sociology 2. organic sociology 3. sociology for community of town and country 4. analysis of social net 5. social constructure and classify research 6. family sociology 7. social work 8. 1) After the completion of getting the ordered credit hour, postgraduates can go start the dissertation; 2) Postgraduates should ,in the second calendar year,finish chosing the topic of dissertation and composing plan under the direction of their tutor,and do thesis statement for the first time .The thesis statement should have 3-5 professional tutors,of whom there must be 3 professors or vice professors.The topic and contents of thesis must have learned or applied value. on a certain extend. 3) During the period of writing thesis, you should join the research project which your tutor presided, to enhance your abilities of the theory research and demonstration research, and its assess of technology and research level should be excuted according to the requirement of "Shanghai University master degree confered by the quantization indication of technology and research results". 4) After finishing the thesis and being confirmed in the pre-answer procedure, which consists of four senior teachers including your tutor, then evaluation and answer for thesis procedure will be organised which concluded specalists in the same field from this school or other institutions. 50 After finishing the thesis, students will be confered master degree according to the evaluation regulation of "The degree regulation of People's Republic of China" and "The rules of Shanghai University degree confered".

duration.text: The Anthropology at Shanghai University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Certificate of English proficiency test IELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker. 7. Certificate of Chinese language education For applying Chinese-medium programs. 8. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. (at least 1 A4 page)

requirements.text: 1. Undergraduate graduation, hold a Bachelor's Degree 2. HSK 6 3. Aged 18 - 40
